description: New Go2 ability task on the existing TM02 strip. No original-task qualification.
actions: two load-transfer styles, continuous x landing shift and COM height. Original force MPC, inverse dynamics WBC and hard plant bounds.
observation: measured sole bottom, force, known flat strip geometry, base velocity, target; plant strain internal state is logged only.
limits: Material fit uses area-weighted world-cell traction-free response and separate zero-load recovery at 8ms observation spacing; walking plant is the original 0.2ms reference material.

study.development: f-forefoot-cost-v1: 10.8033 wall s, 2330 query integration steps, WBC maximum iterations at 0.826 s; measured footprint translated during support so the formal observer tracks world cells.
study.initial_theta: deterministic seed-specific N(0,.08) paired across arms
study.paired_cost: Each sign repeats identical deterministic support and runs its own true query. Absorbing failure charges unexecuted physical time, wall/steps are reported as observed.
study.histories: three full training specimens in registered cycle; two new specimens for evaluation. Fixed checkpoint before unseen rollout. No W59 heldout to select.
study.compute: one real Go2 episode per sign, support/query duration, K two material steps and one finite refinement equal; report actual termination and exposure
study.optimizer: paired Gaussian perturbation estimate of smoothed objective, Euclidean bounded per-step norm. Independent A-only calibration and C-only control with a reference A; sequential first two A then two C; alternating same joint objective with alternating blocks; simultaneous A+C every round.
